mac.notes:
- Google Tasks & Google Calendar sync
- Dated to-dos in memos & projects (📅) show up on that day and sync to Reminders / Google Tasks
- Type @10-12 or @tomorrow on a to-do line for a 📅 date
- System font by default; any installed font via Custom
